name: Subhasmita Tripathy / ଶୁଭସ୍ମିତା ତ୍ରିପାଠୀ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Subhasmita Tripathy writes Odia poetry. In the two poems gathered here, longing takes shape through rivers, flowers, soil and changing colours. These are intimate addresses in which the natural world carries both tenderness and injury.

“ଚିଠି” moves through remembered closeness, absence and a speaker’s refusal to wither through lack of love. In “ଗୋଟେ ପୃଥିବୀ ବାସ୍ନାର ଝିଅ ପାଇଁ”, pink, red and yellow become difficult colours, marked by hurt and separation. The search turns instead towards dew, tears and rainwater: quieter images of vulnerability and closeness.

poems_read.basis: Dew and flowers, cotton cloth contrasted with silk, river and lost nose ornament, mustard-flower path, wet earth enduring neglect, refusal to dry or disappear despite unfulfilled love; ending in pain and unencountered darkness.

poems_read.title: ଗୋଟେ ପୃଥିବୀ ବାସ୍ନାର ଝିଅ ପାଇଁ
poems_read.basis: Butterflies drawn to roses and forgetting grass flowers; thorns and injured finger; red lily, blood and absent lover; yellow mustard and wounded recollection; final wish for dew, warm tears, white butterfly and rainwater colours.
